sources.note: Nothing in prose. Sec. 1.15 'Uamué' pp. 21-22 (survey narrative: three non-fluent men gave words); Intro pp. 8-9 says 47% of List 2 and >=50% of List 3 are plainly Portuguese and the whole Aticum material is under 'forte suspeita'; sec. 3.1 'Aticum. Lista 1/2/3' pp. 29-33 give c. 160 remembered words in phonetic transcription with a primary-stress stroke before the stressed syllable (e.g. àtõ'é 'fogo', pàk'óà 'banana', zítírân'í 'batata', tup'ê 'deus') — token-level marks only, mostly final or penult; Notas pp. 93-94 contain no transcription conventions.
